messages:
maria: morning check-in — content calendar + benchmark post status.
What I did: finalized hero copy for the model-comparison draft.
Blockers: need final p50/p90 numbers from eng for the latency table.
Today: publish draft + request final PR reviews.

sam: added a new tab 'latency-v2' in the calendar sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEFghiJKlmnOPqrs
Filled best-effort numbers from the last automated run, but left the hosted/dedicated p90 blank — @jon can you confirm?

jon: I can pull p50/p90 from the infra dashboard and cross-check.
Just pushed a small patch to bench-runner (see PR: github.com/redwood/bench-runner/pull/234) — pinging @sam for data mapping. ETA ~1h.

akshay: heads-up — I merged the quantization change yesterday that nudges CPU results by ~5–8%. That might shift the narrative a bit. @maria do you want a rerun or a note in the post?

maria: rerun preferred for dedicated + hosted if it's cheap; otherwise add a footnote calling out the quant change. Sam — can you add a footnote?

sam: added a footnote row in the sheet and marked it with TODO. @jon — can you also quick-check the embed-bench snippet? I hit a timeout locally.

jon: seeing that. Suspect the default timeout (10s) is too low for cold-starts on the bench harness. I'll try a quick patch locally and open a PR after smoke tests. Patch snippet below:

```json
{
  "bench_config": {
    "timeout_ms": 30000,
    "batch_size": 8
  }
}
```

If CI passes I'll merge and kick another run.

deploy-bot: CI passed for bench-runner #234 — all checks green :white_check_mark:

tanya: design gave the hero image a final 👍, uploaded asset to s3://redwood-assets/marketing/model-comp-hero.png — used the updated colors from the product palette.

maria: thanks — plan is to publish at 12:30 PT unless we see any blocking changes from eng. I'll update the calendar and post the live link in this thread when done.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll queue the social copy and benchmark callouts right after the live link.

akshay: one small ask — add an experiment tag `quant-updated` to the post metadata so we can trace regressions in the analytics.

maria: done — tag added to the post draft. Last call for comments, otherwise I'll publish on the hour.

jon: quick note — if anyone sees the bench run time jump >15% after merge, ping me and I'll revert/triage.

maria: noted. thanks team! :coffee:
